text: Fixed camera rig: same camera position for every painting
description: Tripod/fixed mount at a constant distance and angle to a wall/easel where paintings are placed; even lighting (avoid glare on varnish). Required for size calibration to stay valid.

status.comment: Rig set up in the attic; the user has done several capture sessions with it (calibrated at 2.51 m, 208 paintings captured in project hirschwangerhof-v2).
